title: Coca-Cola uses AI to improve retailer ordering in Malaysia
summary: Coca-Cola deployed AI-powered recommendation technology through its Coke Buddy platform to help Malaysian retailers optimize their ordering decisions. The Perfect Basket feature uses a Central Recommendation Engine that analyzes historical orders, seasonality, weather patterns, and purchasing behaviors of similar businesses to suggest optimal product quantities.
problem_solved: Helps small Malaysian retailers make smarter inventory ordering decisions to reduce stockouts and overstocking.
why_valuable: Improves supply chain efficiency and strengthens retailer relationships by personalizing recommendations based on local context like weather and seasonal demand patterns.
